Title: Reviews widget renders on the product page when reviews exist or feedback is available
Preconditions: Manual/browser (playwright-chrome). CustomerReviewsEnabled=true on B2B-store. Uses the seeded REVIEW_PRODUCT (run `npm run seed:reviews`) which has approved reviews.
Steps:
[NAV] Open {{FRONT_URL}}/@td(REVIEW_PRODUCT.slug) (the seeded product with approved reviews)
[ACT] Scroll to below the product description
Assertions:
[STATE] The "Feedback" reviews widget renders below the product description
[STATE] Each review shows author name, date, star rating, text, and an image carousel when images exist
[STATE] Average product rating / star summary is shown
Cross_Layer_Checks: [EVIDENCE] Screenshot the reviews widget; note where it is mounted (PDP body vs a tab)
Failure_Signals: widget absent on a product that has approved reviews

[NAV] As an anonymous visitor open a product page
[ACT] Locate the reviews widget
Assertions:
[STATE] The "Leave feedback" button is NOT shown (isAuthenticated=false gate)

Title: Leave feedback button hidden for a logged-in user without a completed order
Preconditions: Manual/browser (playwright-chrome). Log in as a user who has NOT purchased the target product (canLeaveFeedback=false).
Steps:
[NAV] Log in as a user with no completed order for the target product
[NAV] Open that product page
Assertions: [STATE] The "Leave feedback" button is NOT shown (canLeaveFeedback=false: no completed order)

Title: Leave feedback button hidden after the user has already reviewed the product
Preconditions: Manual/browser (playwright-chrome). Buyer already left one review for the product.
Steps:
[NAV] Log in as a buyer who already reviewed a purchased product (create one first if needed, then reload)
[NAV] Open that product page
Assertions: [STATE] The "Leave feedback" button is NOT shown (canLeaveFeedback=false: already reviewed)
Failure_Signals: the button reappears, allowing a second review

Title: Leave feedback + submit: eligible buyer submits a review, gets confirmation, review is pending moderation
Preconditions: Manual/browser (playwright-chrome). Log in as a buyer with a completed order for the product and no prior review (canLeaveFeedback=true).
Steps:
[NAV] Log in as the eligible buyer (USER=John, has a Completed order for the product) and open that product page
[ACT] Locate the review form in the FEEDBACK widget (on theme 2.51 the form renders INLINE for eligible buyers — no separate "Leave feedback" button; older themes may show a "Leave feedback" button that opens it)
[ACT] Observe the Submit button while rating=0 and the comment is empty
[ACT] Set a star rating and enter comment text
[ACT] Click Submit
Assertions:
[STATE] The review form is available (inline for the eligible buyer, or via a "Leave feedback" button if the product already has reviews)
[STATE] Submit is disabled while rating=0 or comment empty (client-side guard); enabled once both are set
[STATE] After submit the form is replaced by the confirmation (verified live, theme 2.51): "Your feedback has been successfully submitted and is awaiting confirmation. Thank you!"
[STATE] The new review is NOT immediately visible in the list (status New, awaiting moderation)
Cross_Layer_Checks: [ADMIN] The submitted review appears in admin Rating and reviews with Status = New
Failure_Signals: review shows on the PDP immediately without moderation; submit enabled with empty rating/text
Cleanup: [NOTE] Delete the created review via admin Rating and reviews after verification

Title: Review form image upload (VcFileUploader, review-images scope)
Preconditions: Manual/browser (playwright-chrome). Eligible buyer, review form open.
Steps:
[ACT] In the open review form upload 1-2 images via the file uploader
[ACT] Remove one image before submitting
[ACT] Submit the review with the remaining image
Assertions:

Title: Reviews list — sort by date and pagination (5 per page)
Preconditions: Manual/browser (playwright-chrome). Uses the seeded REVIEW_PRODUCT (6 approved reviews → page 1 = 5, page 2 = 1). Run `npm run seed:reviews`. Verified live on theme 2.51.
Steps:
[NAV] Open {{FRONT_URL}}/@td(REVIEW_PRODUCT.slug) (seeded product, 6 approved reviews)
[ACT] Change the sort-by-date selector (new to old / old to new)
[ACT] Navigate to page 2
Assertions:
[STATE] Review order updates according to the selected sort
[STATE] Pagination shows 5 reviews per page; page 2 loads the next set
Failure_Signals: sort control does not reorder; more than 5 reviews render on one page

Title: Approved review appears on the product page after moderation (end-to-end)
Preconditions: Manual/browser (playwright-chrome + admin). Cross-layer: submit -> approve -> visible.
Steps:

[NAV] Admin approves it in Rating and reviews
[NAV] Reload the product page as any visitor

Title: Reviews widget mount location and disabled-feature behavior
Preconditions: Manual/browser (playwright-chrome). Confirms where the widget mounts and behavior when the feature is off. Do NOT flip the store setting here (see REV-ADM-008).
Steps:
[NAV] Open a product page with the feature enabled
[ACT] Confirm the reviews widget location on the PDP
Assertions:
[STATE] The reviews widget is a full-width "FEEDBACK" card mounted INLINE in the PDP body (main/left product column, directly below the Description block) — NOT a tab, accordion, or sidebar. A top-of-PDP star summary also renders next to the SKU (verified on theme 2.51)
[STATE] With CustomerReviewsEnabled=false (a disabled env) the FEEDBACK widget/form does not render
Failure_Signals: widget renders while the feature is disabled

Title: Review comment has no length limit (no client maxlength/counter; server accepts 6000+ chars)
Preconditions: Manual/browser (playwright-chrome). Eligible buyer, review form open. Verified live on theme 2.51: the comment textarea has NO maxlength attribute and NO character counter, and the server persisted a 6016-char review (CustomerReview.Review has no [StringLength]). Documents the current unbounded behavior — a mild validation gap.
Steps:
[NAV] As the eligible buyer open the review form on a purchased product
[ACT] Set a rating and type a very long comment (e.g. 6000+ characters)
[ACT] Submit
Assertions:
[STATE] The comment field does not truncate or show a max-length error, and no character counter is displayed (no client-side cap)
[STATE] Submit succeeds and the server persists the full-length review (no server-side length cap on CustomerReview.Review)
[NOTE] If a max length / counter is later introduced, update this case (it would then cap or reject over-limit text)
Cross_Layer_Checks: [EVIDENCE] Live: 6016-char review created (status New) and read back at full length via admin search
Failure_Signals: comment is silently truncated without any indication; or an over-length review is rejected with no message
Cleanup: [NOTE] Delete the created review via admin after verification
